name: maroto-component-aware-render-layout-trace
instr:
Maroto cannot expose the relationship between a document's component structure and what it renders. Add an immutable, page-indexed layout trace without changing document output, measurement, pagination, metrics, saving, or merging.

Each item needs deterministic semantic identity, tree position, final page coordinates, occupied bounds, and only its logical component's provider operations. Calculate bounds as rendering does for barcodes, QR codes, file images, byte images, signatures, and configured-grid columns, including provider dimensions and image displacement. Keep barcode and QR operations and measurement rules distinct. File images expose paths without loaded bytes. Byte-image identity is bounded and extension-sensitive and never retains buffers. Keep signature text and line operations together and ordered.

Distinguish duplicate values by position. Identities must match between structure inspection and generation. Equal-valued components across columns and an automatic page break retain insertion order, distinct hierarchy positions, and final page ownership. Adjacent barcode and QR components receive only their matching operations. A top-offset file image in a partial-grid column reports its occupied final-page geometry.

Existing `Component` implementations remain valid and receive generic records. Make `LayoutTrace` observations defensively immutable. `Pages` and `Find` must report final one-based pagination consistently.

Empty, repeated, concurrent, and low-memory
